The engine adds the chain fields (companion OSS issue); this issue makes the schemas + the independent verifier describe and check them, and defines the three anchor-signed artifacts. in_scope: - "`schemas/envelope.json` (additive): `producer_id`, `sequence`, `prev_hash`, `history_integrity` (enum `local_unanchored | anchored`) — mirroring the engine struct field-for-field (code is truth)" - "New schemas: **ledger receipt** `{ledger_id, envelope_hash, sequence, recorded_at, sig}`; **history slice** `{scope, since, actions[], head_hash, sig}`; **compaction checkpoint** `{sequence_from, sequence_to, reason, prior_head, new_head, sig}`" - "`rust/rigorix-verifier`: verify a per-producer chain (sequence monotonic + `prev_hash` continuity) and the anchor signatures (Ed25519) once the anchor exists; accept a gap iff covered by a valid signed checkpoint" - "Fixtures: a chained envelope run; a broken-chain fixture; a compaction checkpoint covering an erased range; an anchor-signed history-slice fixture" - "Canonicalization doc: `prev_hash` and `envelope_hash` are over the same canonical bytes as the HMAC (`signature` nulled) — one canonical form, no second dialect" out_of_scope: - "The engine implementation (OSS Phase A) and both servers (Phases B/C)" - "SSE (`GET /events`) — that is SDK-C1 / ADR-0002 (rigorix-sdk#10)" - "Host-side asymmetric keys (Phase D)" affected_layers: schemas: - "modify: schemas/envelope.json" - "create: schemas/api/ledger-receipt.json, schemas/api/history-slice.json, schemas/api/compaction-checkpoint.json" - "create: schemas/fixtures/integrity/*" rust: - "modify: rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs — chain + signature verification" docs: - "modify: schemas/README.md, schemas/api/README.md" canonical_references: - adr: "rigorix-oss engine/.pi/architecture/decisions/ADR-016-audit-integrity-anchor.md (Contract, Modes, GDPR/compaction)" - code: "rigorix-oss engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs; engine/src/audit/application/envelope_factory_impl.rs:50 (canonical form)" - precedent: "schemas/api/catalog.json + ADR-0001 (freeze-before-build); rust/rigorix-verifier (protocol-only)" acceptance_criteria: - "[ ] `envelope.json` carries the four additive fields; all_schemas_compile + catalog/integrity tests green" - "[ ] The three anchor-signed artifact schemas compile and have fixtures" - "[ ] `rigorix-verifier` verifies a chain (monotonic sequence + prev_hash continuity) and REJECTS a broken chain (missing/reordered/altered predecessor)" - "[ ] The verifier accepts an erased range IFF covered by a valid signed checkpoint; an uncovered gap fails" - "[ ] Canonicalization is documented and the fixtures prove byte-exact reproduction" - "[ ] Field names match the engine struct exactly (code is truth); additive-only within the format major" - "[ ] CI green (fmt · clippy · test)" validators: [ci, architecture, canonical] implementation_notes: | - Mirror the engine struct exactly — do not invent names. `history_integrity` values are `local_unanchored` / `anchored`. - One canonical form: `prev_hash`/`envelope_hash` hash the same bytes the HMAC signs (envelope with `signature: None`), so the chain and the signature can never disagree. The existing canonicalization contract in envelope.json's description is the reference. - Keep the verifier protocol-only (no `rigorix-engine` dependency, D-1). - Legacy (unchained) envelopes: the verifier should treat absent chain fields as "unknown predecessor, chain-of-one" and report it (not silently pass as chained). file_changes: - "modify: schemas/envelope.json" - "create: schemas/api/{ledger-receipt,history-slice,compaction-checkpoint}.json" - "create: schemas/fixtures/integrity/" - "modify: rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs" pipeline_steps: [implement, validate, create-mr, merge] ```
# SDK-AUDIT-A: Audit integrity contract (SDK) ## Intent Freeze the ADR-016 contract before the servers implement it: envelope chain fields, the three anchor-signed artifacts, and independent verifier support (chain + anchor signature + compaction proofs). ## In Scope - `envelope.json` additive: `producer_id` / `sequence` / `prev_hash` / `history_integrity`. - New schemas: ledger receipt, history slice, compaction checkpoint (+ fixtures). - Verifier: chain verification; accept gaps only when covered by a signed checkpoint. - Canonicalization documented (one canonical form shared with the HMAC). ## Out of Scope - Engine/servers (companion issues). SSE (SDK-C1 / #10). Phase D. ## Canonical References - **ADR-016** (Contract, Modes, GDPR/compaction) - `engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs`, `envelope_factory_impl.rs:50` - Precedent: `schemas/api/catalog.json` + ADR-0001 ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | Envelope additive fields; schemas compile | CI test | | 2 | Three anchor artifacts have schemas + fixtures | CI test | | 3 | Verifier accepts a valid chain, rejects a broken one | unit | | 4 | Erased range OK iff covered by a signed checkpoint | unit | | 5 | Field names == engine struct | review + fixture | | 6 | CI green | CI | ## DoD - [ ] Envelope + three artifact schemas + fixtures landed - [ ] Verifier chain + checkpoint verification landed - [ ] Canonicalization documented; CI green
title: SDK-AUDIT-A: Envelope integrity contract — chain fields + receipt / history-slice / compaction schemas + verifier support

unknown types fall through to a generic error (never panic)" - "Batch request + notification framing tested (JSON-RPC array + no-`id`)" - "`rigorix.system.version` negotiation: the client exposes the constraints it requires" - "Live e2e (Rust → C2): plan → run → audit.read round-trips and validates against the result schema" - "No client surface exposes raw step execution (catalog scan / type review)" - "CI green (fmt · clippy · test)" validators: - ci - architecture - security - canonical implementation_notes: | - Reuse, don't invent: types MUST mirror `catalog.json` `$defs` field names exactly (serde field names tracked code-truth). Guardian contract (machine-readable front matter — parsed by the Guardian pipeline) ```yaml guardian_issue: id: "SDK-C1" title: "Specify the SSE push channel (GET /events) — reconnect, Last-Event-ID, event payloads" epic: "server mode — C: catalog → servers → clients (D-5 / D-012)" status: planned priority: high created_at: "2026-09-22T00:00:00Z" dependencies: - name: "rigorix-sdk ADR-0001 (catalog freeze)" type: internal note: "Done — schemas/api/catalog.json + ADR-0001. This issue closes its 'Open items' (push semantics)." intent: | Before either server is built (C2 OSS `rigorix-server`, C3 enterprise Execution API), freeze the push channel that ADR-0001 deliberately left open. ADR-0001 D1/D8 fixed the transport ("separate event stream, `GET /events`, SSE") and the event-name set (`approval_required`, `run_progress`, `policy_changed`) but explicitly deferred reconnect / `Last-Event-ID` semantics and the exact event payloads "to the server implementations". C2 and C3 must not invent those independently — one spec, both servers, one conformance corpus. in_scope: - "ADR-0002 'SSE push channel' (Accepted): endpoint, SSE framing, reconnect, Last-Event-ID, heartbeat/retry hint, ordering, backpressure, per-session auth, poll fallback" - "`schemas/api/events.json` — the three event payloads as a discriminated union on the SSE `event:` name, reusing `envelope.json` event-ref shapes (never a second envelope dialect)" - "A normative mapping table: engine `ExecutionEvent` variants -> the three SSE event names (which variant becomes `run_progress` vs `policy_changed` etc.), so both servers emit identical streams" - "Fixtures under `schemas/fixtures/events/` — one per event, evidence-backed where the event carries evidence; verifiable with the frozen `rigorix-verifier`" - "`schemas/api/catalog.json` `transport.push` references the new schema; integrity test extended" - "State the auth level + identity invariant for `/events` (D5: events are scoped to the attested session; the stream never leaks another session's runs)" out_of_scope: - Implementing either server's HTTP layer (C2 / C3 own that) - MCP Streamable HTTP (an adapter over this surface, later) - The legacy MCP SSE endpoint (stays removed — GAP-A-10; never resurrect) - Changing the frozen event-name set (additive only within the `apiVersion` major; a new name is a contract change) - Transport for `/rpc` (already frozen: JSON-RPC 2.0 over `POST /rpc`) affected_layers: docs: - "create: docs/adr/ADR-0002-sse-push-channel.md" schemas: - "create: schemas/api/events.json" - "create: schemas/fixtures/events/approval-required.json" - "create: schemas/fixtures/events/run-progress.json" - "create: schemas/fixtures/events/policy-changed.json" - "modify: schemas/api/catalog.json (transport.push -> $ref events.json)" - "modify: schemas/api/README.md, schemas/README.md" tests: - "modify: rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs (all_schemas_compile / a new events conformance case)" canonical_references: - adr: "docs/adr/ADR-0001-native-api-catalog.md — D1 (transport), D8 (push channel), 'Open items' (this issue)" - schema: "schemas/api/catalog.json -> transport.push { kind: sse, endpoint: /events, events: [approval_required, run_progress, policy_changed] }" - schema: "schemas/envelope.json (v2) — event refs: event_type, status, payload.step_name; $id keyed" - schema: "schemas/api/errors.json — error taxonomy (the stream is not JSON-RPC; errors are stream-framed)" - code: "rigorix-oss engine/src/event_system/domain/event.rs — ExecutionEvent variants + event_type_name()" - docs: "rigorix-oss docs/next-workstreams-2026-09-21.md §C1; docs/sdk-server-strategy-freeze-2026-09-06.md D-4" - test: "rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs — all_schemas_compile, catalog_integrity" acceptance_criteria: - "ADR-0002 merged and Accepted" - "`schemas/api/events.json` compiles and defines all three payloads as a discriminated union on the SSE event name" - "Every fixture validates against events.json; evidence-carrying fixtures verify with the frozen rigorix-verifier" - "The engine `ExecutionEvent` -> SSE event-name mapping table is complete (every run-relevant variant is assigned; none silently dropped)" - "catalog.json `transport.push` references events.json; all_schemas_compile + catalog_integrity green" - "Reconnect semantics are unambiguous: what the client sends (Last-Event-ID), what the server MUST replay, what it MAY drop, and the documented poll fallback (`rigorix.audit.read`)" - "`/events` auth level + per-session scoping stated; no cross-session leakage path" - "CI green (fmt · clippy · test)" validators: - ci - architecture - canonical implementation_notes: | - This is a SPEC issue — the only "code" is schema + fixtures + tests. No server. - Reuse, don't invent: the event ref shape already exists in `envelope.json`. `events.json` must reference it (`$ref`), not redefine `event_type`/`status`. - `Last-Event-ID`: SSE ids must be monotonically ordered per stream. Decide the id format (e.g. `:` or a store cursor) and bound the replay window; state explicitly what happens when the requested id is older than the window (resync via `rigorix.audit.read`, no silent gap). - Heartbeat: comment frames (`: ping`) on an interval so proxies do not idle-close; document `retry:` so clients back off sanely. - Backpressure: a slow consumer must not stall execution — per-session bounded buffer + documented drop/replace policy (mirrors `AuditEnvelopeDropped`). - Ordering: within an `execution_id`, events are emitted in engine order; across runs, no global order is promised. - Mapping hint (verify against event.rs, do not trust this list blindly): `run_progress` <- PlanningStarted/Completed, NodeStarted/Completed/Failed/ Retrying, ToolExecuted, ExecutionCompleted/Failed/Cancelled; `approval_required` <- approval-pause variants (ApprovalRecorded / the pause state) bound to the attested subject (ADR-011); `policy_changed` <- SequencePolicyDenied, SequenceRuleMatched, RequirementUnmet, RequirementPromoted, ScopeViolationRecorded, plus enterprise policy-bundle version changes. - Keep the schema additive-only within `apiVersion` 1.x. file_changes: - "create: docs/adr/ADR-0002-sse-push-channel.md" - "create: schemas/api/events.json" - "create: schemas/fixtures/events/" - "modify: schemas/api/catalog.json" - "modify: schemas/api/README.md" - "modify: rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs" pipeline_steps: - implement - validate - create-mr - merge ```
# SDK-C1: Specify the SSE push channel (`GET /events`) ## Intent Freeze the push channel before either server exists. ADR-0001 fixed the transport and the event-name set but deferred reconnect / `Last-Event-ID` semantics and the exact payloads. This issue produces the single spec (ADR-0002) + machine schemas + fixtures that **both** C2 (`rigorix-server`, OSS) and C3 (enterprise Execution API) implement. Without it, the two servers will diverge on the first reconnect. ## Dependencies ``` ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐ │ C1 SSE spec (THIS ISSUE, rigorix-sdk) │ └───────────────┬───────────────────────┘ │ unblocks ┌────────┴────────┐ ▼ ▼ C2 rigorix-server C3 enterprise (OSS, oss repo) Execution API ``` - **ADR-0001 (done)** — the catalog freeze this ADR closes the open items of. ## In Scope - **ADR-0002** — SSE endpoint, framing, reconnect + `Last-Event-ID`, heartbeat, retry hint, ordering, backpressure, per-session auth, poll fallback. - **`schemas/api/events.json`** — the three payloads, discriminated on the SSE `event:` name, reusing `envelope.json` event refs. - **Mapping table** — engine `ExecutionEvent` → SSE event name (normative). - **Fixtures** — one per event, verifiable with `rigorix-verifier`. - **catalog.json** `transport.push` → schema reference; integrity test extended. ## Out of Scope - Any server implementation (C2 / C3). - MCP Streamable HTTP; the legacy MCP SSE endpoint (GAP-A-10 — stays removed). - New event names / changing the frozen set. ## Affected Layers ### Docs - New: `docs/adr/ADR-0002-sse-push-channel.md` ### Schemas - New: `schemas/api/events.json`, `schemas/fixtures/events/*.json` - Modified: `schemas/api/catalog.json` (`transport.push`), `schemas/api/README.md` ### Tests - Modified: `rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs` (schema integrity + events conformance) ## Canonical References - **ADR-0001** `docs/adr/ADR-0001-native-api-catalog.md` — D1, D8, Open items - **catalog** `schemas/api/catalog.json` → `transport.push` - **envelope v2** `schemas/envelope.json` - **engine events** `engine/src/event_system/domain/event.rs` - **backlog** `rigorix-oss docs/next-workstreams-2026-09-21.md` §C1 ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | ADR-0002 merged + Accepted | review | | 2 | `events.json` defines all three payloads (discriminated union) | `all_schemas_compile` | | 3 | Fixtures validate + evidence fixtures verify | `rigorix-verifier` | | 4 | `ExecutionEvent` → event-name mapping is complete | review + test | | 5 | `catalog.json` push references the schema | `catalog_integrity` | | 6 | Reconnect/`Last-Event-ID`/replay window + poll fallback unambiguous | review | | 7 | `/events` auth + per-session scoping stated; no cross-session leak | review | | 8 | CI green (fmt · clippy · test) | CI | ## Implementation Notes - **Spec-only.** No server code. Reuse `envelope.json` event refs (`$ref`, do not redefine `event_type`/`status`). - **`Last-Event-ID`:** monotonic per-stream ids; bounded replay window; an id older than the window MUST resync via `rigorix.audit.read` (no silent gap). - **Heartbeat / retry:** comment frames so proxies don't idle-close; document `retry:`. - **Backpressure:** per-session bounded buffer; slow consumer never stalls execution. - **Ordering:** engine order within an `execution_id`; no global order across runs. - **Mapping hint** (verify against `event.rs`): `run_progress` ← planning/node/tool/ completion variants; `approval_required` ← the approval-pause event (bound to the attested subject, ADR-011); `policy_changed` ← sequence/requirement/scope variants + enterprise bundle version changes. ## DoD - [ ] ADR-0002 Accepted - [ ] `events.json` + 3 fixtures + tests green in CI - [ ] `catalog.json` push block references the schema - [ ] C2/C3 issues reference this spec as the normative source
